v0.1.62.source:
从 0.1.61 升级，完善 Agent 修改请求、任务恢复与项目交付，并提供可供 HOL Guard 审查的 CLI 命令描述。

- 新增 Agent 修改请求：将区域蒙版或 Relax Flow 标注、修改要求与源图版本固定保存；支持原子领取、执行身份校验和结果回填，信息不完整时先澄清。保存请求本身不调用模型。
- 历史记录区分“复用提示词”和“还原任务”，保存原模型、编辑源与参考图片职责，避免把旧编辑任务还原成普通生图。
- 支持取消尚未提交的排队图片任务，保留应用级三任务并发；已提交任务不宣称远端取消或停费，中断后的不确定结果明确标为“结果未知”。
- 新增独立于当前预览版本的最终稿，以及固定源版本的项目交付配方：支持用途、相对目录文件名、尺寸、PNG/JPEG/WebP 编码，导出 ZIP 与 SHA-256 manifest，默认不覆盖文件。
- Provider 默认采用不提交生成请求的只读检查，分别展示联网、鉴权、模型目录与未验证的实际能力；主动测试图片生成需要单独确认可能产生的费用。
- 生成设置直接显示模型、尺寸、有效质量与张数；FIELD 完整示例新增源图、改色、场景、海报与交付章节，可定位真实图片和版本。
- CLI 提供离线可读的 Guard 描述文件，不安装 Guard、不改写 Agent 权限。生成、编辑、文件导出、配置安装与通用调用按影响区分；未知通用调用保持审查，整体决策仍由 Guard 全局策略决定。
- 官网补齐英文产品、功能、下载、配置和排障路径，明确官网预制体验、隔离网页开发与桌面本地保存的边界。FIELD 示例提供可导入画板与完整项目包。

安装包：

- macOS Apple 芯片：`Iterlay-0.1.62-arm64.dmg`
- macOS Intel 芯片：`Iterlay-0.1.62-x64.dmg`
- Windows x64：`Iterlay-0.1.62-x64.exe`
- Windows ARM64：`Iterlay-0.1.62-arm64.exe`

随附 `SHA256SUMS.txt`，用于校验下载文件。

永久免费开源，AI 调用费用由你连接的服务商收取。安装包未使用 Developer ID / Windows 代码签名，macOS 未公证。

平台限制：系统照片分层依赖 macOS 14+；按需下载的视频处理组件目前提供 macOS ARM64 版，其他平台需要自行配置 FFmpeg / FFprobe 才能使用依赖这些工具的本地处理功能。Guard 描述的上游收录、Guard 版本发布与用户主动启用是独立步骤，不代表自动安装或激活保护。

发布流程要求类型检查、Lint、单元测试、生产构建与隔离网页冒烟测试通过，四种安装包通过内容和体积审计，再校验版本、文件名与 SHA-256。离线模型测试、构建和包审计不等同于真实收费模型或各平台真机功能验收。
v0.1.62.en:
Upgrading from 0.1.61: improved agent edit requests, task recovery and project delivery, with a CLI command descriptor for HOL Guard review.

- Agent edit requests save a region mask or Relax Flow annotations, requirements and the source image version. Atomic claiming, execution-identity checks and result reporting are supported; incomplete requests require clarification. Saving a request does not call a model.
- History distinguishes reusing a prompt from restoring a task. It preserves the original model, edit source and reference-image roles so an old edit is not restored as ordinary image generation.
- Cancel queued image tasks that have not been submitted. The application-wide limit remains three concurrent tasks. Submitted tasks are not claimed to be remotely cancelled or no longer billed; uncertain outcomes after interruption are explicitly marked as unknown.
- Final selections are independent of the currently previewed version. Project delivery recipes pin source versions and specify purpose, relative paths, filenames, dimensions and PNG/JPEG/WebP encoding. Export ZIP files with a SHA-256 manifest without overwriting files by default.
- Provider checks are read-only by default and do not submit generation requests. Connectivity, authorization, model listings and unverified capabilities are shown separately. A live image-generation test requires separate confirmation of possible charges.
- Generation settings show the model, dimensions, effective quality and quantity. The full FIELD example adds source, color edit, scene, poster and delivery chapters linked to actual images and versions.
- The CLI supplies an offline-readable Guard descriptor. It does not install Guard or change agent permissions. Generation, editing, exports, configuration installation and generic calls are classified by impact. Unknown generic calls remain subject to review; Guard global policy still determines the decision.
- The website adds English product, feature, download, setup and troubleshooting paths, and explains the boundaries between prepared website demos, isolated browser development and local desktop saving. FIELD includes an importable board and a complete project package.

Installers: macOS Apple silicon (Iterlay-0.1.62-arm64.dmg), macOS Intel (Iterlay-0.1.62-x64.dmg), Windows x64 (Iterlay-0.1.62-x64.exe), Windows ARM64 (Iterlay-0.1.62-arm64.exe). SHA256SUMS.txt is included for download verification.

Permanently free and open source. Your connected provider bills AI usage. Installers have no Developer ID or Windows code signature; macOS packages are not notarized.

Platform limits: system photo-layer separation requires macOS 14+. The optional downloadable video-processing component currently supports macOS ARM64; other platforms need separately configured FFmpeg/FFprobe for local features that depend on them. Upstream acceptance of the Guard descriptor, a Guard release and user enablement are separate steps; the descriptor does not automatically install or activate protection.

The release process requires type checks, lint, unit tests, production builds and an isolated browser smoke test, followed by content and size audits of all four installers and checks of versions, filenames and SHA-256 hashes. Offline model tests, builds and package audits are not live paid-model tests or functional acceptance on physical devices for every platform.

v0.1.57.source:
Iterlay 0.1.57 — 永久免费的 MIT 开源版。

- 删除激活、试用期限和功能限制，离线启动即可使用全部本地功能。
- 移除 Iterlay 官方图像、文本和视频 Provider，以及积分、报价、购买和邀请奖励入口。
- 保留自定义 Provider 与已有 API Key；请连接自己的模型服务，模型费用由对应服务商收取。
- 更新检查与安装包下载改用 GitHub Releases；官网和下载页通过 GitHub Pages 提供。
- 平台：macOS Apple 芯片（ARM64），要求 macOS 14 或更新版本。本次未发布 Intel 或 Windows 安装包。
- 未使用 Developer ID 签名，未公证。首次打开时 macOS 可能提示开发者无法验证，可从系统设置 → 隐私与安全性中允许打开。
- 包内 FFmpeg 6.0 / x264 r3222 从源码构建，未启用 nonfree；随 Release 提供第三方对应源码、构建脚本与 SHA-256 校验和。

验证：1705 项测试通过，源码构建通过；安装包启动、永久免费状态、自有 Provider 默认配置及内置 FFmpeg/FFprobe 已验证。未在其他 macOS 版本的实际机器上验证；仓库仍有既有 lint 问题。
v0.1.57.en:
Iterlay 0.1.57 — the permanently free, MIT-licensed open-source edition.

- Removed activation, trial periods and feature restrictions. All local features are available when starting offline.
- Removed official Iterlay image, text and video providers, credits, quotes, purchases and referral rewards.
- Retained custom providers and existing API keys. Connect your own model service; that provider bills model usage.
- Update checks and installer downloads now use GitHub Releases. The website and download page are hosted on GitHub Pages.
- Platform: macOS Apple silicon (ARM64), macOS 14 or later. No Intel or Windows installer was released.
- No Developer ID signature or notarization. macOS may warn that the developer cannot be verified; allow opening in System Settings → Privacy & Security.
- Bundled FFmpeg 6.0 / x264 r3222 was built from source without nonfree enabled. Corresponding third-party source, build scripts and SHA-256 checksums accompany the release.

Validation: 1,705 tests and the source build passed. Package startup, permanently free status, custom-provider defaults and bundled FFmpeg/FFprobe were verified. Other macOS versions were not tested on physical devices. Existing repository lint issues remained.
